class.name: TickSynchronizerBuffer
class.brief_description: Reads and writes deterministic bit fields and explicit numeric codecs over a PackedByteArray.
class.description: Provides the binary foundation used by the TickSynchronizer protocol. Bit fields are processed least-significant bit first. Fixed-width integers therefore use little-endian byte order when aligned. Variable-length integers require byte alignment and use a canonical representation. Float codecs use explicit IEEE 754 binary32 or binary64 widths and never serialize real_t directly. Storage growth is limited by [method set_max_size_bytes], and read inputs are copied into a canonical logical representation. Equality and hashing use only canonical bytes and bit size. The first operation error is persistent until [method clear], [method begin_write], or [method begin_read] is called. This class is not internally synchronized for concurrent access.

method.name: align_read_to_byte
method.description: Advances the read cursor to the next byte boundary. Skipped padding must be zero. Nonzero padding returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_DATA], and truncated padding returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_FILE_EOF].

method.name: align_write_to_byte
method.description: Writes zero padding until the write cursor reaches the next byte boundary.

method.name: begin_read
method.description: Starts reading from [param data]. When [param bit_size] is [code]-1[/code], every bit in the array is readable. A smaller logical size can exclude padding bits in the final byte.

method.name: can_write_bits
method.description: Returns whether [param bit_count] positive bits can be written without exceeding the configured limit. Returns [code]false[/code] outside write mode or after an operation error.

method.name: begin_write
method.description: Starts a new write operation and optionally reserves byte capacity without changing the logical size.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears data, cursor, mode, and error state.

method.name: get_bit_position
method.description: Returns the current read or write cursor in bits.

method.name: get_bit_size
method.description: Returns the logical number of valid bits.

method.name: get_byte_size
method.description: Returns the number of stored data bytes currently exposed by [method get_data].

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the backing bytes. Use [method get_bit_size] to preserve the logical size of a partial final byte.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the first persistent error, or [constant @GlobalScope.OK].

method.name: get_content_hash
method.description: Returns a non-cryptographic 32-bit hash of canonical bytes and logical bit size. Hash equality does not replace [method is_equal_to], and the value is not part of the wire format.

method.name: get_max_size_bits
method.description: Returns the configured maximum size in bits.

method.name: get_max_size_bytes
method.description: Returns the configured maximum storage size in bytes.

method.name: get_mode
method.description: Returns the current buffer mode.

method.name: get_remaining_write_bits
method.description: Returns the number of bits still available under the configured limit in write mode, otherwise [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_remaining_bits
method.description: Returns unread logical bits in read mode, otherwise [code]0[/code].

method.name: has_error
method.description: Returns whether a persistent error has been recorded.

method.name: is_byte_aligned
method.description: Returns whether the current cursor is on a byte boundary.

method.name: is_equal_to
method.description: Returns whether [param other] has the same logical bit size and canonical bytes. Cursor, mode, errors, limits and reserved capacity are ignored.

method.name: is_reading
method.description: Returns whether the buffer is in read mode.

method.name: is_writing
method.description: Returns whether the buffer is in write mode.

method.name: read_bits
method.description: Reads 1 to 64 bits. Returns [code]0[/code] when an error occurs; inspect [method has_error] and [method get_last_error]. A 64-bit pattern whose highest bit is set is represented as a negative GDScript integer.

method.name: read_float32
method.description: Reads an IEEE 754 binary32 pattern at the current bit position and promotes it to the 64-bit GDScript float type.

method.name: read_float64
method.description: Reads an IEEE 754 binary64 pattern at the current bit position.

method.name: read_u16
method.description: Reads an unsigned 16-bit integer at the current bit position.

method.name: read_u32
method.description: Reads an unsigned 32-bit integer at the current bit position.

method.name: read_u64
method.description: Reads a 64-bit pattern at the current bit position. Values with bit 63 set appear negative in GDScript.

method.name: read_u8
method.description: Reads an unsigned 8-bit integer at the current bit position.

method.name: read_varint
method.description: Reads a byte-aligned canonical ZigZag variable-length signed integer.

method.name: read_varuint
method.description: Reads a byte-aligned canonical variable-length unsigned integer. The GDScript API supports values up to [code]9223372036854775807[/code]; the C++ API supports the full [code]uint64_t[/code] range.

method.name: set_max_size_bytes
method.description: Sets the maximum storage size. The value must be positive and cannot be lower than currently allocated storage. Configuration failures do not set the persistent codec error.

method.name: write_bits
method.description: Writes the lowest 1 to 64 bits of [param value] in LSB-first order.

method.name: write_float32
method.description: Converts [param value] to IEEE 754 binary32 and writes its 32-bit pattern. Finite GDScript values outside the binary32 range return [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: write_float64
method.description: Writes the IEEE 754 binary64 pattern of [param value].

method.name: write_u16
method.description: Writes an unsigned 16-bit integer at the current bit position.

method.name: write_u32
method.description: Writes an unsigned 32-bit integer at the current bit position.

method.name: write_u64
method.description: Writes the 64-bit pattern of [param value] at the current bit position.

method.name: write_u8
method.description: Writes an unsigned 8-bit integer at the current bit position.

method.name: write_varint
method.description: Writes [param value] as a byte-aligned canonical ZigZag variable-length signed integer.

method.name: write_varuint
method.description: Writes a nonnegative GDScript integer as a byte-aligned canonical variable-length unsigned integer. The C++ API supports the full [code]uint64_t[/code] range.

constants.constant: Default defensive storage limit of 1 MiB. Protocol and transport layers should normally configure smaller limits.
Largest accepted configured byte limit, chosen so conversion to bits cannot overflow a signed 64-bit integer.
